spans.s: नेम m. 1. A part; 2. a period, a season; 3. loundary, enclosure, fence; 4. the foundation of a wall; 5. fraud, deceit; 6. a ditch; 7. evening.
नेमि(मी) f. 1. the circumference or felly of a wheel, R.i.17, 39; 2. edge, rim; 3. a windlass; 4. a circle or circumference in general, R.ix.10; 5. a thunderbolt; 6. the earth.
